text:
Marta: heads-up — scheduling a phased NIC firmware update + GPU soft-reboot across apac-east2 and us-east1 tonight 02:00-05:30 UTC. target is minimal customer impact, 3 cohorts, staggered by 25% capacity each.
Alex: ETA/TL; can you share cohort mapping? also any Dedicated pools affected?
Marta: cohort mapping attached in the runbook (link): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nic-fw-apac-eus-2026. Dedicated pools are excluded except az-edge-interruptible pool which we’ll swap for the window.
Priyanka: on Dedicated — we should confirm tenant pinning. If any tenant pinned to the cohort, we'll migrate them to standby racks first. I can run the migration job but need a heads-up 30m prior.
Marta: noted. we'll emit reservation-change for pinned tenants 45m before start. Priyanka please own the migration window.
Kai: quick capacity calc: with 25% cohort drains, preheat needed for kvcache and batch queues. Recommending pre-seed command at -40m:
```
infractl cohort preheat --pool=apac-edge --cohort=1 --kvcache=seed --batchers=2
```
Jordan: what about routing fallback? we should route latency-sensitive requests to us-east1 during apac cohort. Any cost estimate for cross-region egress?
Marta: good call — routing policy will prefer local region unless cohort in progress. If apac cohort in progress we'll route some SLAs to us-east1. Cost delta forecast ~ +$3.5k for window (back-of-envelope).
Alex: risk checklist: 1) NIC firmware may temporarily increase packet drops 2) GPU driver reload could prompt single-node restarts 3) KV cache cold miss spike. Can we add a short runbook step to reduce generator batch_size to 1 for 10m after each cohort?
Marta: yes, adding that. Will push a config flip at +5m post-cohort:
```yaml
routes: 
  - name: reduce-batch-after-reboot
    set: { generation.batch_size: 1 }
    duration: 10m
```
Priyanka: I'll schedule the tenant migrations 30m prior and watch for stuck workloads. please ping me in thread when each cohort starts.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421. Owners: Marta, Priyanka, Kai. Slack bridge: #inc-9187654321. Pager schedule invoked for oncall.
Kai: monitoring checklist on my side: queue depth, p50/p99 latency, kv miss rate, gpu-util. I'll add temporary alerts: p99 latency > 600ms or kv miss rate > 20% -> pager.
Jordan: do we have a rollback play? if NIC fw causes regression we should stop and roll back firmware on that rack only. What’s the firmware rollback time?
Marta: rollback per rack ~18-25m. Plan: stop after cohort if severe. Will annotate the runbook with per-rack rollback commands.
Alex: are we blocking scheduled batch jobs during the window? those cause big KV churn.
Marta: yes — blocking low-priority batch jobs across apac for the window and +30m. Running adhoc clear: `infractl jobs suspend --tags=batch --region=apac-east2` at -15m.
Priyanka: I’ll coordinate comms to affected customers (dedicated + reserved pools). Draft message ready, will post at -60m.
Marta: final checklist before we start: 1) preheat done -40m (Kai) 2) tenant migrations -30m (Priyanka) 3) pause batch jobs -15m (Marta) 4) cohort1 cordon+reboot 02:00 UTC (infra team) 5) observe 10m, then cohort2 03:10, cohort3 04:20 6) post-window KV warmup and batch-size revert.
Jordan: I’ll stand by for routing flips. If any spike, flip routing immediately and throttle new streaming sessions.
Marta: thanks team. I’ll update the calendar invite and post runbook link in #status. ping here when you’re ready. :thumbsup:
maint-bot: calendar event created: NIC-FW-Phased-2026-04-21 02:00-05:30 UTC. Runbook pinned.
oncall-bot: reminder scheduled at 01:15 UTC.
